proposals.semantic_law: For finite acyclic first-order terms, unify two terms while refusing any new binding V:=T when V occurs inside T; observable success/failure plus induced substitution. SWI special case with ALREADY cyclic inputs is non-portable and excluded.
proposals.behavioral_neighbor: Current D10 PROLOG-SUBSTITUTIONS-TO-DATALOG-FACTS is a projection of prior substitutions, not the sound unification relation; shared behavior needs exhaustive review
proposals.derivable: Pure finite-term unification can be implemented in self-hosted Lisp; selection as a Core primitive is not yet justified.
proposals.owner_review: core vs selfhost library; occurs check outside D2 control

proposals.semantic_law: Monotonic disequality constraint on two terms: immediate success if terms cannot unify, failure if equal, otherwise residual delayed constraint preventing future bindings that make them identical. Distinct from immediate syntactic non-equality or D1 1-bit boolean comparison.
proposals.result_cardinality: success with residual state or failure
proposals.behavioral_neighbor: D10 forward-rule matcher tests facts after substitution; dif/2 imposes a persistent future constraint on a logical variable, not mere matching.
proposals.derivable: Attributed-variable store and fair wakeup implementation maybe self-hosted library; dependency and root irreducibility not proven.
proposals.owner_review: Does monotonic constraint state belong language-visible value or runtime-owned solver? Hold

proposals.semantic_law: Copy a term with fresh variables while extracting pending attribute constraints as explicit residual goals G. Replaying G restores the constraints onto the copy; copying alone DOES NOT implicitly preserve them for copy_term/3.
proposals.result_cardinality: copied term and ordered/list residual-goal representation
proposals.behavioral_neighbor: Existing Prolog-to-Datalog fact projection is not explicit reconstruction of attributed variable constraints; behavior dedup must inspect D9 graph/dataset laws.
proposals.derivable: Likely higher-level transformation using constraint store; HOLD for a library rather than consume a primitive slot.
